As of August 26, 2026, I'm spending all my time on these things:

- Raising 6 kids (19, 16.5, 14, 11, 8.5, and 4.5) and trying to stay sane ([family blog](http://www.heissatopia.com/)); the oldest is studying at Brigham Young University and will be serving an 18-month LDS mission in Hanoi, Vietnam starting in September; the others are all at home
- Living in Doha and working as an assistant professor of international politics and policy at [Georgetown University in Qatar](https://guq.qatar.georgetown.edu/)
- [Researching](https://www.andrewheiss.com/research/) anti-NGO restrictions, human rights, and statistical methods for nonprofit and public administration
- Teaching [quantitative methods for international relations](https://quantf26.classes.andrewheiss.com/) at [Georgetown University in Qatar](https://guq.qatar.georgetown.edu/)
- Working as an occasional data science mentor for [Posit Academy](https://posit.co/products/enterprise/academy/)
- Reading some sort of religiously themed text every day ([books](https://www.goodreads.com/review/list/2733632-andrew-heiss?shelf=religious))
